posts.title: tuez-gayz
posts.description: She's a professional dancer; I am mortified stiff to dance sans rhythm. The bar has a backyard area. Sky’s navy Fence strung with pink lights I watch her smoke cigarettes Resisting a draw. And/or confession. An unspoken dynamic is a nearly-blank page White except for faint markings of an emerging sketch; It holds potential. Which is exciting. Also There is a sense of purity.

posts.title: Ethel Cain
posts.description: the lights were flashing in time to the music and i was oh so conscious of the girl beside me
